# Kolte-Patil Life Republic Hinjewadi

> Kolte-Patil Life Republic is a 390-acre integrated, green, gated township located in Hinjewadi-Marunji, Pune West (Maharashtra, India 411057). Developed by Kolte-Patil Developers Ltd. (NSE: KOLTEPATIL, BSE: 532924) and marketed by PropSmart Realty (Authorized Partner, MahaRERA: A52100019166).

## Executive Overview

- **Township Name**: Kolte-Patil Life Republic (also known as Life Republic Hinjewadi)
- **Developer**: Kolte-Patil Developers Limited (Founded 1991, 30+ years track record, 50+ delivered projects)
- **Total Scale**: 390+ contiguous acres
- **Master Architect**: Hafeez Contractor
- **Current Resident Population**: 20,000+ residents (12,000+ happy families)
- **Geo Coordinates**: 18.5913° N, 73.7389° E
- **Micro-Market**: Hinjewadi / Marunji / Punawale / Tathawade corridor, Pune West
- **Official Portal**: https://life-republic.in
- **Authorized Representative**: PropSmart Realty (Contact: +91 93705 52525 / +91 77760 30158, propsmartrealty@gmail.com)

## Township Infrastructure & Master Amenities

- **Education**: Crimson Anisha Global School (CBSE curriculum, ICSE accredited, operational with 1,500+ students inside the township).
- **Spine Road**: 150-foot wide arterial expressway passing directly through the township connecting Marunji to Hinjewadi and Punawale.
- **Fire Station**: Dedicated on-site Kolte-Patil municipal-grade fire station for round-the-clock emergency safety.
- **Central Park**: 3.5-acre landscaped urban park, reflexology walkways, botanical conservatory, and amphitheatre.
- **Water & Power**: Captive 24/7 dual-source water management, RO treatment, stormwater harvesting, and 100% DG power backup for essential services.
- **Security & Surveillance**: 5-tier sovereign security network, automated boom barriers, RFID vehicular scanning, 500+ HD CCTV cameras, and 24/7 patrol squads.
- **Retail & Daily Living**: 50,000+ sq.ft. high-street retail galleria, supermarkets, cafes, medical clinic, banking ATMs, and EV charging stations.
- **Sports & Fitness**: Olympic-length swimming pool, full-size cricket pitch, multiple tennis & badminton courts, outdoor crossfit arena, and 4 lavish clubhouses.

## Connectivity & Location Advantages

- **Hinjewadi Phase 1 (Infosys, Wipro, Tata Tech)**: 4.5 km (8 to 10 minutes)
- **Hinjewadi Phase 2 (Cognizant, Tech Mahindra)**: 6.0 km (12 minutes)
- **Hinjewadi Phase 3 (TCS, Megapolis, Barclays)**: 7.5 km (15 minutes)
- **Upcoming Hinjewadi Metro Line 3 (Megapolis to Civil Court)**: 4.0 km (7 minutes)
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway (Somatne / Dehu Road junction)**: 8.5 km (12 minutes)
- **Wakad Flyover / Bhumkar Chowk**: 7.0 km (14 minutes)
- **Baner / Balewadi High Street**: 13.0 km (20 minutes)
- **Pune International Airport (Lohegaon)**: 32 km (45 to 55 minutes)
- **Upcoming Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA)**: 95 km (75 minutes via Expressway)

## Investment Fundamentals & Rental Yields

- **Average Price Appreciation (2020 - 2026)**: 12.4% compound annual growth rate (CAGR).
- **Gross Rental Yield**: 5.8% to 7.2% annually, driven by Hinjewadi's 400,000+ IT workforce.
- **Typical Rental Incomes**:
  - 1 BHK: ₹18,000 - ₹22,000 / month
  - 2 BHK: ₹26,000 - ₹34,000 / month
  - 3 BHK: ₹38,000 - ₹50,000 / month
  - 4 BHK / Villas: ₹65,000 - ₹1,10,000 / month
- **Capital Gains Catalyst**: Completion of the 110-meter PCMC Ring Road and Metro Line 3 commercial operationalization.
